model_note: Per-cut: quantile Gradient Boosting trained on real history when >= 180 observations AND beats seasonal-naïve baseline on held-out walk-forward test. Otherwise parametric seasonal-drift fallback. Every cut shows its `model` tag and — if GBM — its `backtest` RMSE comparison.
convention: Best = P10 · Base = P50 · Worst = P90 (80% central band).
